name: Bonaire
summary: A yellow upper-hoist triangle and blue lower-fly triangle separated by a white band, with a red six-pointed star inside a black compass ring on the white.
origin: The flag was adopted on 15 December 1981, when Bonaire was part of the Netherlands Antilles. Since 2010 Bonaire is a special municipality of the Netherlands.

colors.name: Yellow
colors.meaning: The sun and the island's flowers.

colors.name: Red
colors.meaning: The star; the blood of the people.

symbols.name: Six-pointed star
symbols.description: A red star inside a black compass ring.
symbols.meaning: The six original villages; the compass shows the islanders' seafaring skill.

facts: Bonaire is known for its flamingos and coral reef diving.
Since 2010 it has been part of the Netherlands as a special municipality.
Its currency is the US dollar.
clues: Yellow and blue triangles divided by white, with a red star in a compass ring.
Its star's six points are six original villages.
A special municipality of a European country in the Caribbean.
